description: An unpinned origin resolves from the store at origin/<key>, the key the SHA-256 of its properties in name order (git=...\npath=map\n, as sha256sum computes it); the reading notes it once (KDLITH-LOC010) with the stored tree's digest and exits 0 even under --warnings-as-errors, since a note never fails a run
